attributes.title: A screen that feels calm
attributes.brief: What 'calm' looks like to this person in a work app: the layout, density and colour choices they reach for when asked for calm.
attributes.prompt: Describe a screen for keeping track of your team's work that would feel calm to you. Anything: what's on it, how full it is, the colours.
attributes.subject: a work app screen for tracking a team's tasks
attributes.editPrompt: Is this calm to you? Change one thing to make it more so.
